items.title: A variant of the criterion for properties of coherent sheaves, testing on sheaves with prescribed scheme theoretic support

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a variant of the earlier criterion: instead of demanding a supply of subsheaves of each ideal multiple, it asks for a single coherent sheaf with prescribed scheme theoretic support satisfying the property, and concludes the property for all coherent sheaves (statement lines 2778-2793). The proof discharges the two conditions of the initial criterion, the second by a minimal counterexample among reduced irreducible subspaces, comparing the ideal powers with the supplied sheaf through the preparation and filtration lemmas, and closing with an intersection argument for two ideals. The minimal counterexample comparison is the substance, so the claim is H2.
